title: Golden Ace vs. Dangerous Tekkers
summary: Tanahashi and Ibushi’s dream partnership meets Taichi and Zack Sabre Jr.’s ruthless teamwork. The challengers expose the strain beneath the Golden Ace alliance.

chapters.title: The Tekkers take the tag titles
chapters.result: Taichi and Sabre defeat Tanahashi and Ibushi.
chapters.context: The champions’ defeat and post-match humiliation put Tanahashi’s vulnerability at the center of the rivalry.

chapters.title: Golden Ace cannot recover the belts
chapters.result: Dangerous Tekkers retain against Golden Ace.
chapters.context: The rematch confirms the new champions’ advantage and leaves the dream team without its hoped-for redemption.
